name: PratikHesap Net Brüt Maaş Hesaplama Aracı
author: WPMedya

sections.description:
A gross-to-net salary calculator for Turkey based on 2026 labor law parameters. Embed with shortcode: [net_brut_hesapla_free]

Free Features:
* Gross-to-net calculation for 2026
* 12-month table view
* SGK (social security), unemployment insurance, income tax, stamp tax breakdown
* Minimum wage income tax exemption
* 4 color themes (navy, gray, blue, green)
* Custom color picker

Pro Version:
* Historical calculations for 2010–2025
* Net-to-gross calculation
* Print / PDF export

For Pro version or feedback: veyselcicekler@gmail.com

Usage: [net_brut_hesapla_free]
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the plugin.
  2. Go to Settings → Net-Brüt Maaş (Free) to choose a color theme.
  3. Use the shortcode: [net_brut_hesapla_free]
sections.changelog:
1.0.1

  • WordPress.org review feedback addressed: unique prefix and shortcode naming updates.

1.0.0

  • Initial release.
